## Correct Form Cues (Key Points)

- **Banded External Rotation:** Elbow at 90°, tucked to side, wrist neutral, rotate forearm outward without moving upper arm.

- **Prone Y-T-Ws:** Lie face down, arms overhead (Y), out to side (T), then bent (W); lift arms just off floor, squeeze shoulder blades, keep neck relaxed.
- **Serratus Punches:** Lying on back, arms straight up, push dumbbells toward ceiling by protracting shoulder blades, then return.
- **Thread the Needle:** On all fours, reach one arm under body, rotate torso, then return and reach up; keep hips square.
